alumni.name: Jackson Spencer
alumni.bio: Gatorade National Boys Cross Country Player of the Year (2025–26) and Nike Cross Nationals champion. Spencer swept both premier national XC titles, went undefeated all season, and set the all-time course record at Woodward Park (14:16). He holds the Timpanogos Invitational boys course record (15:02) and is committed to BYU.

alumni.name: Jane Hedengren
alumni.bio: Gatorade National Girls Cross Country Player of the Year (2024–25), Nike Cross Nationals champion, and three-time Utah 5A state champion. Hedengren set U.S. high school records in the 5,000m (15:13) and the mile (4:26). She is the two-time individual champion at the Timpanogos Invitational and holds the girls course record (17:38). Now competing at BYU.

alumni.name: Daniel Simmons
alumni.bio: Two-time Gatorade National Boys Cross Country Player of the Year (2022–23 and 2023–24) — only the third athlete ever to win back-to-back. Simmons set the U.S. high school indoor 5,000m record (13:38) and the outdoor 5,000m national record (13:25). He was a two-time Utah 6A state champion and two-time NXR Southwest champion, and signed with BYU.

alumni.name: Rory Linkletter
alumni.bio: 2013 Timpanogos Invitational individual champion. Linkletter became one of Canada's greatest distance runners — a 2024 Paris Olympian, two-time World Championships marathoner, and Canadian half marathon record holder (59:49). A six-time All-American at BYU, he owns the second-fastest marathon time in Canadian history (2:06:49).

alumni.name: Raygan Peterson
alumni.bio: 2023 national champion in the girls 2,000m steeplechase at Nike Outdoor Nationals, run at Hayward Field in Eugene. Peterson was also an All-American in 2022, a cross country state champion (2021), and a multiple-time 4x400 and 4x800 state champion. She now runs cross country and track at BYU.

alumni.name: Tayson Echohawk
alumni.bio: 2022 Timpanogos Invitational individual champion and Utah 5A state champion. Echohawk ran the fastest 5,000m by a Utah high school runner at the time (14:24), was a two-time NXR Southwest runner-up, and earned All-American honors at RunningLane Nationals. He went on to run cross country at the University of Oregon.
